name: docusign
description: DocuSign agreement workflows via DocuSign's hosted MCP server. eSignature envelopes, User Management, Workflow Builder orchestration, and Agreement Manager — 21 tools across four API groups. Browser OAuth (Confidential Authorization Code Grant), no API keys.

connection.instructions: Sign in with your DocuSign account. The DocuSign MCP server requires Confidential Authorization Code Grant — click Connect and you will be redirected to DocuSign to authorise access. An Integration Key with a Client Secret and admin-approved scopes (signature, impersonation) is required before connecting.
